messages:
Samir (AE): Kicking off pilot eval harness plan for AcmeCorp POC. Need alignment on success criteria, golden dataset ownership, timeline, and pricing constraints. High level: 2 week pilot, prefer VPC/private option, expect retrieval + extraction use cases.

Lucy (Solutions Eng): Thanks — good start. Proposed success metrics to discuss: 1) retrieval semantic sim (cosine) >= 0.85, 2) field extraction EM >= 95% on golden set, 3) generation latency p95 < 200ms, and 4) human qual check: mean score >= 4/5 on 50 random cases. Thoughts? :thinking_face: @Devon

Devon (Product): Those are sensible. For scoring I'd do weighted aggregate: semantic_sim (0.5), extraction EM (0.35), latency penalty (0.1), human eval (0.05). Regression gate: any new model that drops aggregate score by >5% vs baseline fails the gate. We should also define the baseline model/version and dataset snapshot.

Samir (AE): Baseline = redwood-stable-v1 (hosted) as used in demo. Acme will provide ~500 labeled extraction examples + ~1k retrieval queries; we need to clarify 'golden' vs 'seed' data.

Lucy (Solutions Eng): Recommendation: customer provides a labeled golden set (the true ground-truth) of ~500 examples that we lock for evaluation. We'll also augment with a synthetic seed set for stress tests. Who owns sanitization? @Anya

Anya (SRE): We can do ingestion in a private intake bucket in their VPC. We require a sanitized copy (PII redacted) for hosted trial; for Dedicated/Private we can ingest raw but must set up KMS and audit logging. Timeline to provision environment ~3 business days after dataset handoff.

Priya (Security): From Acme's security questionnaire they flagged: data residency (EU), KMS for keys, SOC2 + audit logs, and unilateral deletion controls. For pilot we can enable VPC + customer-managed KMS. Need to confirm contract clause for ephemeral test data. I'll loop legal if necessary.

Lucy (Solutions Eng): Eval harness design notes: - Harness will compute embeddings via redwood-embed-compact, use cosine similarity. - Extraction scoring uses normalized exact match + token-level tolerance for formatting. - Latency measurement uses 95th percentile over 1000 synthetic requests. - Human eval: crowd/SE spot-check with rubric. Example prompt/test format we will accept (JSONL):

```
{"id":"inv-001","type":"extraction","prompt":"Extract invoice_total","input":"Invoice 2023-01. Total: $1,234.56","gold":"1234.56"}
{"id":"ret-042","type":"retrieval","prompt":"Find policy about refunds","input":"customer support logs...","gold":"doc-12345"}
```

Lucy (Solutions Eng): Scoring snippet (conceptual):

```
score = 0.5 * cos_sim_score + 0.35 * extraction_em + 0.1 * latency_score + 0.05 * human_score
pass = (score >= baseline_score - 0.05)
```

Samir (AE): Pricing ask from Acme: can we offer 2-week free pilot credits and a hard token cap to avoid surprise billing? They requested cost estimate up front.

Devon (Product): We can offer up to $5k credits for the pilot. Overages billed at standard hosted rate for the pilot model, or we can switch to Dedicated pricing if they need hard caps. Add note: quantization and lower-cost model variants can be enabled for cost experiments.

Lucy (Solutions Eng): For the harness run command (internal):

```bash
python tools/run_eval.py --model redwood-stable-v1 --dataset acme_golden.jsonl --out results/acme_pilot.json --emb-model redwood-embed-compact
```

Lucy (Solutions Eng): Config knobs we'll test: batch_size, kv_cache_enabled, quantize_int8. We should record token consumption and per-request cost in the results.

EvalBot: scheduled run queued for 2024-11-07 09:00 UTC (placeholder) :robot_face:

Anya (SRE): Ops note — ingestion checklist: 1) dataset in S3 (VPC endpoint) 2) KMS alias provided 3) minimal IAM role for ingestion 4) retention policy <= 30d for pilot. I can provision infra after Samir uploads sanitized dataset.

Priya (Security): Action: I'll prepare a short addendum for the SQA covering KMS and deletion controls. Need Acme security contact and signature.

Samir (AE): Action items: - Samir: collect golden file from Acme (due EOD Fri) - Lucy: prepare eval harness repo + sample prompts (due Mon) - Anya: ready infra template & checklist (due Mon) - Priya: SQA addendum draft (due Tue) - Devon: confirm $5k credit approval with finance (due Wed)

Lucy (Solutions Eng): One more ask: ask Acme for top 10 critical prompts/use-cases they care about so we can prioritize golden examples. Short, concrete prompts help the human eval.

Samir (AE): Will message Acme and ask for the 10 prompts + their security contact. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

Devon (Product): If any blockers pop up (residency/contract), ping me and I'll escalate with Legal.

Samir (AE): Thanks everyone, closing this thread until I have the dataset.
